posts.title: Praise God from Whom All Sparrows Flow
posts.description: The season of gratitude has begun. A bird told me so. But the goal of Thanksgiving isn’t to celebrate a thankful day; it’s to become, more and more, a thankful people.

posts.title: Prayer Musings from Vireo Videos
posts.description: Some birds throw some vocal pauses into their repertoire. And in prayer, the Spirit can do a lot with the pauses between the notes in your song.

posts.title: Birders Are Not Murderers (An Open Letter to Siri)
posts.description: Dear Siri. Birders are not murderers. I really feel as though I’m enunciating properly. Perhaps you’re taking a theological approach to this? Is that it?
